3d video me voice kaise dale:
Boss, 3D video mein voice daalne ke do mukhya tarike hain:
1. UE5 Sequencer mein Audio Track laga kar .wav/.mp3 voice file timeline par set karein.
2. 3D video render hone ke baad FFmpeg ya video editor se voice audio ko video ke saath merge karein taaki audio-video sync bilkul saaf rahe.
ue5 sequencer audio track: Boss, Unreal Engine 5 ke Sequencer mein `+ Track -> Audio Track` chunein aur apni narration ya dialogue audio file add karke camera/scene animation ke saath time match karein.
ffmpeg se video me voice kaise jode:
Boss, video aur voice audio ko mila kar final .mp4 banane ke liye FFmpeg command:
```bash
ffmpeg -i video.mp4 -i voice.mp3 -c:v copy -c:a aac -shortest output_with_voice.mp4
```
3d video with voice workflow:
Boss, voice ke saath 3D video banane ka poora kram:
1. Script likhein aur voice (recording ya TTS jaise edge-tts) taiyar karein.
2. Voice ki timing ke hisab se UE5 mein scene/camera animation aur Sequencer set karein.
3. Video render karein aur audio merge karke final output banayein.
video prompt kaise nikale:
Boss, kisi bhi video ya scene se video prompt nikalne/banane ke liye 4 cheezein likhein:
1. POV / Camera Angle: First-person POV, wide shot, ya close-up.
2. Subject & Action: Kaun si cheez hai aur usmein kya action/motion ho raha hai.
3. Setting & Lighting: Jagah, din/raat ki roshni aur realistic/3D look.
4. Audio / Voice: Voiceover script aur sound timing.
pov action video prompt aur workflow:
Boss, POV action/gaming-style video ke liye prompt structure:
• Visual Prompt: 'First-person POV shot showing hands holding a controller in front of a dark truck in an open lot; sudden dramatic movement and dynamic camera shake, realistic lighting.'
• Workflow: Pehle scene/3D animation ya video clip banayein, phir sound effects aur voiceover add karein.
explainer shorts video prompt aur workfl:
Boss, fact/explainer shorts ke liye prompt structure:
• Hook (0-5 sec): Ek tez sawal ya chaunkane wali baat.
• Body: Aasan shabdon mein kaaran aur example.
• Voice + Visual: Clear Hindi voiceover ke saath matching visuals/diagrams aur final video encoding.
kisi bhi bhasha me code likhne ka niyam:
Boss, koi bhi code likhne ke liye pehle 3 baatein tay karein:
1. Input kya aayega aur output kya chahiye.
2. Kaam ko chhote functions/steps mein baantein.
3. Error handling aur test run karein.
